name: WM-ABench (Prediction Protocols)
summary: 以受控仿真中的状态预测、机械模拟和反事实推断评测内部世界模型。
summaryEn: Evaluates internal world models through state prediction, mechanistic simulation and counterfactual inference.

wmNote: 入选范围为预测协议；不能将颜色、形状等静态感知子任务单独算作世界模型数据。
wmNoteEn: Inclusion concerns prediction protocols; static color/shape perception subtasks do not independently qualify.

evidence.statement: The prediction stage uses controlled simulated environments to test mechanistic simulation, transitive inference and compositional inference, including object interactions and robot actions. Inclusion is explicitly limited to this predictive scope.
